scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/contracts build && bun run --cwd packages/server build && bun run --cwd packages/react build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/contracts typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/server typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/react typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.backend.json
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/contracts test && bun run --cwd packages/server test && bun run --cwd packages/react test
scripts.pack:check: bun run --cwd packages/server pack:check && bun run --cwd packages/react pack:check
scripts.lint: biome check packages scripts tests examples
scripts.verify: bun run contracts:check && bun run docs:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:backend && bun run build && bun run examples:check && bun run verify:consumer
scripts.examples:check: bun run --cwd examples/integrations typecheck && bun run --cwd examples/integrations build && bun run --cwd examples/quickstart typecheck
